TG.lastDelivery.title: The Last Delivery
TG.lastDelivery.notImported: Import The Last Delivery adventure (all content) before using its control panel.
TG.lastDelivery.scaling.4: Alley: Chika alone, retreats after her first wound. Clinic: Riku alone or talked down. Station: Kurose alone; Chika neutral.
TG.lastDelivery.scaling.5: Alley: Chika alone. Clinic: Riku, plus Chika only if the alarm rings. Station: Kurose, plus Riku if he escaped.
TG.lastDelivery.scaling.6: Alley: Chika, plus Riku from round 2. Clinic: Riku and Chika unless recruited. Station: Kurose, Riku and Chika only if both stay loyal.
TG.lastDelivery.pressure.0: Calm. The station runs on schedule.
TG.lastDelivery.pressure.1: The station is alerted. Kurose's people watch the entrances.
TG.lastDelivery.pressure.2: Chika guards the loading ramp (token revealed unless she changed sides).
TG.lastDelivery.pressure.3: Kurose pockets the ledger and starts loading the patients. The group still arrives before the van leaves.
TG.lastDelivery.npc.recruited: {actor} joins the party's side and leaves every encounter.
TG.lastDelivery.npc.captured: {actor} is restrained and will not reappear in later scenes.
TG.lastDelivery.woundsCarried: Wounds carried into {scene} for {count} NPC token(s).
TG.lastDelivery.noPreviousScene: The first scene has no earlier wounds to carry.
